title: Merge sssd 2.6.3-1 from Debian unstable.
description:
Merge sssd 2.6.3-1 from Debian unstable.

Trivial merge.  There is one delta that's been dropped (picked up by Debian), but otherwise everything is left as is.

One (python3-click) of two sssd-tool's dependencies that were making it uninstallable on i386 was dropped by Debian, but the other (python3-systemd) is still there so we should still not build the binary on that architecture.

There's a PPA with the proposed changes here:

https://launchpad.net/~sergiodj/+archive/ubuntu/sssd-merge/+packages

autopkgtest is still OK (though you need to run it with all-proposed enabled, because of Python 3.10):

autopkgtest [22:19:44]: @@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ summary
ldap-user-group-ldap-auth PASS
ldap-user-group-krb5-auth PASS
